description:
Located on a quiet cul-de-sac, this inviting 2800+ sq ft 4 Bedroom +3 Bath traditional two-story home offers a spacious and open floor plan designed for comfortable living and entertaining.

The main areas include a living room with high ceilings, a family room with a fireplace that flows seamlessly into the expansive center-island kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances, a five-burner stove, and a window overlooking the large grassy backyard. The dining room space can easily accommodate large dinner parties and holiday celebrations. 

There are four generously sized bedrooms and three updated bathrooms, including a spacious primary suite with a large walk-in closet and an oversized bathroom with a double vanity.

Hard-surface flooring runs throughout the home, complemented by modern conveniences such as dual-paned windows, recessed lighting and a Nest thermostat.

Additional highlights include a dedicated indoor laundry room with extra storage, a two-car attached garage and a beautiful backyard with a covered patio, offering plenty of space for outdoor enjoyment.
